# Smartsheet

> Personalize workflows, predict outcomes, and move faster with Smartsheet – a platform built for the way you work.

The Smartsheet AI-powered platform transforms work management into a personalized, predictive engine — helping you work the way you want, at the speed you need.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.smartsheet.com/): Smartsheet's homepage
- [Platform](https://www.smartsheet.com/platform): Discover Smartsheet, the enterprise-grade work management platform. Built to scale with your needs, Smartsheet empowers seamless collaboration and drives results across all use cases.
- [Pricing](https://www.smartsheet.com/pricing): Explore flexible Smartsheet pricing options, tailored to fit any team's needs. Compare plans to find the perfect solution for streamlining your workflow and boosting productivity.

## Resources

- [Content Center](https://www.smartsheet.com/content-center): Your resource for information, inspiration, and expert tips and best practices to help you improve the way you work.
- [Smartsheet Templates](https://www.smartsheet.com/template-gallery): Streamline your work with the perfect template for your team.

## Content

- [Gantt Charts](https://www.smartsheet.com/gantt-chart-guide): Learn what a Gantt chart is &amp; how to quickly build one. See examples of Gantt charts, and find a Gantt chart software for your projects.
- [Project Management](https://www.smartsheet.com/project-management-guide): From all about the project lifecycle to how to select the right methodology and software for your team, discover all there is to know about project management in this comprehensive guide.
- [Task Management](https://www.smartsheet.com/content/task-management-software): Manage tasks with ease using Smartsheet. Plan, prioritize, and automate team workflows in one collaborative platform.
